scoring_options.4: Pages are numbered, entries are ordered chronologically or by section, and a table of contents leads to specific entries.
scoring_options.3: Pages are numbered with a table of contents, but finding an entry takes searching.
scoring_options.2: Some organization is present, but locating information is difficult.
scoring_options.1: No pagination or table of contents. Information cannot be located.

scoring_options.4: The team number appears on the notebook, and all entries are signed or initialed by the student who wrote them.
scoring_options.3: The team number appears, and most entries are attributed to a student.
scoring_options.2: The team number appears, but entries are rarely attributed.
scoring_options.1: The team number is missing, or entries are not attributed at all.

scoring_options.4: Dated entries span the season, demonstrating a consistent habit of notebooking.
scoring_options.3: Dated entries span the season, showing notebooking habits with some gaps.
scoring_options.2: Entries cluster in a few short periods, or large stretches of the season are missing.
scoring_options.1: Entries are undated, or all appear to have been created at one time.

scoring_options.4: Outside sources (designs, mechanisms, code, and ideas the team built on) are named where they appear.
scoring_options.3: Most outside sources are named, though some appear without credit.
scoring_options.2: A few sources are named, or credits appear only as a list, not where they were used.
scoring_options.1: Outside work appears with no credit.

scoring_options.4: The notebook defines and explains the problem along with the rules and constraints that could impact possible solutions.
scoring_options.3: The notebook defines a problem without explanation,and lists related criteria and constraints.
scoring_options.2: A problem is defined without specific criteria or limits.
scoring_options.1: The problem to be solved is not defined and no criteria and constraints appear.

scoring_options.4: The notebook describes the team's scoring priorities with reasoning and tradeoffs that come with those priorities.
scoring_options.3: The notebook describes the team's scoring priorities with some reasoning. No tradeoffs are documented.

scoring_options.4: Several distinct approaches (coding, engineering, and/or strategy) are recorded with enough detail to see how they differ.
scoring_options.3: Three or more approaches are recorded without comparison, or one or two ideas appear with comparison.
scoring_options.2: One or two ideas appear with no comparison.
scoring_options.1: No brainstorming appears, or a single solution appears already chosen.
